rv.q: All told, I can’t fully endorse or discount this funny-peculiar West End interloper – it’s plainly tosh, possibly a masterpiece.
But there’s no resisting the exuberance of Death Drop.
Overall, Death Drop is an evening of frothy fun and games with a talented cast of drag stars enjoying this nicely written and affectionate homage to the queen of murder mystery.

cn.t: This campy drag whodunnit parody starts broad but wins over critics with its exuberance and novelty. The Agatha Christie spoof delivers arch humor and outlandish performances in a uniquely West End spectacle.
